Name: Date Night
Author: LiveOnSUPERT
Description:
[color=#00ff00][size=5][b]UPDATED TO VERSION 1.3.0 ON MAY 24, 2022!
[/b][/size]Please remove the previous version completely before installing the updated version.

[b][size=4]Changelog:[/size]
[/b][spoiler] [/color]ADDITIONS:
- added 4 new dates!
- Generic: Camping Date: Your spouse may ask you to accompany them to go camping on a sunny spring, summer, or fall day when leaving the farmhouse between 6 am and 11 pm. Enter the forest after 8 pm after agreeing to date to trigger.
- Generic: Grocery Store Trip: Your spouse might ask you to accompany them to the grocery store on Mondays of any weather and any season. Enter Pierre's Shop between 9 am and 5 pm after agreeing to trigger.
- Spouse-Specific: Maru "Lunar Eclipse": Maru will always ask for this date on the 15th of every month when leaving the farmhouse between 6 am and 8 pm. Enter the backwoods after 8 pm after agreeing to date to trigger.
- Spouse-Specific: Alex "Two Tickets For The Tunnelers": Alex may ask for this date on a Sunday when leaving the farmhouse between 6 am and 3 pm. Enter the Bus Stop after 12 pm but before 7 pm to trigger.

FIXES:
- altered certain dialogues that referred to the player to be more gender-neutral due to a request to do so
- added specific compatibility with Ridgeside Village 2.1 (new marriage candidates sean + kiarra will now have unique foods and unique music during specific dates, and fixed broken music themes during dance date due to rsv changing its unique id for music)
- added unique foods + music for Adventurer's Guild Expanded spouses Gabriel and Zinnia - it's my new mod! check it out if you haven't already ;)
[color=#00ff00][/spoiler]

Hope you enjoy the update! I tested all the events multiple times so there shouldn't be any issues, but please please comment if you get a bug/error! Also, thanks to everyone who submitted date ideas! You are all so creative! I will definitely take inspiration from these for future updates!
[/color]
[size=5][b][img]https://i.imgur.com/O0SUMJN.png[/img][/b][/size]

Something I noticed about marriage in this game is that after you see your Spouse's 14-Heart Event, there's no more showcases of your relationship or bond together. 

This mod aims to fix that! It adds events where you can spend time with your spouse on a date.

Currently, there are many generic dates for all Spouses and even some spouse-unique dates, but I have planned more, including unique dates for each of the Vanilla Spouse Candidates and even more generic dates.

This page is for the English version. If you want another language, please check the list of currently translated languages at the bottom of this page.

[b][size=5][img]https://i.imgur.com/cn9HLy2.png[/img][/size][/b]

You can request/suggest different dates for specific spouses (or just generic ones) in the form linked below. This will help me immensely as I plan to expand on this mod a lot to provide a lot more variety to the married/dating life in Stardew Valley! All suggestions will be looked at, so please feel free to share your ideas! (Thank you RememberEmber for this idea!)

[url=https://forms.gle/pfLrvQyhjbVpoq5i8][size=3]Click Here To Share Your Date Ideas!
[/size][/url]
[b][size=5][img]https://i.imgur.com/pSq9iOo.png[/img][/size][/b]

There is a[b] 10%[/b] (configurable) chance that your Spouse will ask for a date every day[b] if you have at least 10 hearts[/b] (configurable) with them. The date request will be initiated once you leave the farmhouse.

There are currently the following different types of dates that your Spouse can ask you for. You can view the details for them below.

[b][color=#c27ba0][size=4]Generic Dates (All Spouses):[/size][/color][/b]
[spoiler][b]Saloon Date [/b]
[i]Any Weather, Any Season[/i]
Your spouse will ask after leaving the farmhouse anytime from [b]6:00 AM - 3:00 PM[/b].
To trigger the date, [b]enter the Saloon after 6 PM[/b] after agreeing to the date.

[b]Forest Date [/b](thank you to Dollyevida, Carnagemaker98, and a kind stranger for inspiring parts of this date!)
[i]Sunny/Windy Weather, Spring/Summer/Fall[/i]
Your spouse will ask after leaving the farmhouse anytime from [b]6:00 AM - 11:00 AM[/b].
To trigger the date, [b]enter Cindersap Forest between 11:00 AM - 3:00 PM[/b] after agreeing to the date.

[b]Library Date [/b](thank you to Dollyevida and RubyRedChaos for inspiring parts of this date!)
[i]Rainy/Stormy Weather, Spring/Summer/Fall [b][u]or[/u][/b]
Any Weather, Winter[/i]
Your spouse will ask after leaving the farmhouse anytime from [b]6:00 AM - 3:00 AM[/b].
To trigger the date, [b]enter the Library/Museum anytime[/b] after agreeing to the date.

[b]Beach Date [/b](Thanks to PinkParadox and many kind strangers for inspiring this date!)
[i]Sunny Weather, Summer[/i]
Your spouse will ask after leaving the farmhouse anytime from [b]6:00 AM - 3:00 AM[/b].
To trigger the date, [b]enter the Beach from 10:00 AM - 4:00 PM[/b] after agreeing to the date.

[b]Dance Date [/b](Thanks to Dollyevida for inspiring this date!)
[i]Any Weather, Spring/Summer/Fall/Winter Day 1[/i]
Your spouse will always ask for this (no matter your date ask percent setting) on the first day of any season after leaving the farmhouse anytime from [b]6:00 AM - 3:00 PM[/b]. The dance is triggered automatically at the farm.

[b]Camping Date[/b]
[i]Sunny Weather, Spring/Summer/Fall[/i]
Your spouse may ask you to accompany them to go camping on a sunny spring, summer, or fall day when leaving the farmhouse between [b]6 am and 11 pm[/b]. [b]Enter the forest after 8 pm[/b] after agreeing to the date to trigger.

[b]Grocery Date [/b](Thanks to Asydic for inspiring this date!)
[i]Any Weather, Any Season, Mondays [/i]
Your spouse might ask you to accompany them to the grocery store on Mondays of any weather and any season after leaving the farmhouse between[b] 6 AM - 3 PM[/b]. [b]Enter Pierre's Shop between 9 am and 5 pm[/b] after agreeing to trigger.
[/spoiler]

[color=#93c47d][size=4][b]Alex[/b][/size][/color]
[spoiler][b]Two Tickets For The Tunnelers[/b] (Thanks to a kind stranger for their idea!)
[i]Any Weather, Any Season, Sundays[/i]
Alex may ask for this date on a Sunday when leaving the farmhouse between [b]6 am and 3 pm[/b]. [b]Enter the Bus Stop after 12 pm but before 7 pm[/b] to trigger.
[/spoiler]

[b][color=#1e84cc][size=4]Emily:[/size][/color][/b]
[spoiler][b]Sadness Cleansing Gem [/b](Thanks to RubyRedChaos for their idea!)
[i]Any Weather, Any Season[/i]
Emily will ask you on this date after leaving the farmhouse anytime from [b]6:00 AM - 7:00 PM[/b].
To trigger the date, [b]enter Haley/Emily's house anytime[/b] after agreeing to the date.
[/spoiler]

[color=#ffe599][size=4][b]Haley:[/b][/size][/color]
[spoiler][b]The Desert Photgrapher [/b](Thank you to Dollyevida and PinkParadox for inspiring this date!)
[i]Any Weather, Any Season [u][b]after fixing the Bus.[/b][/u]
[/i]Haley will ask you on this date after leaving the farmhouse anytime from [b]6:00 AM - 4:00 PM[/b].
To trigger the date, enter the Bus Stop between [b]6:00 AM - 5:00 PM[/b] after agreeing to the date.
[/spoiler]

[b][color=#a64d79][size=4]Maru[/size][/color][/b]
[spoiler][b]Lunar Eclipse[/b]
[i]Any Weather, Any Season, Day 15[/i]
Maru will always ask for this date on the 15th of every month when leaving the farmhouse between [b]6 am and 8 pm[/b]. [b]Enter the backwoods after 8 pm[/b] after agreeing to date to trigger.
[/spoiler]

There are currently these config options that you can edit in the [b]config.json[/b] file created after running your game with the mod installed or by using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]:

[b]DateAskPercentChance[/b]: Change the % chance that your spouse will ask for a date every day. Can be any % chance from 0 (disables asking for a date) to 100 (spouse will ask for a date every day). [b][Default: 10%]

MinHeartsRequired[/b]: Change the minimum number of hearts required with your spouse for them to ask you on a date. Can be any number 0 (will ask you even if they hate you) to 14 hearts (will only ask after you become soulmates). [b][Default: 10 Hearts]

FriendshipBonus[/b]: Change the amount of friendship received with your spouse if you go on a date with them. 'none' will disable any friendship bonuses, 'small' will increase friendship by 25 points (1/10 of a heart), 'medium' increases by 50 points (2/10 of a heart), and large increases by 100 points (4/10 of a heart). [b][Default: medium][/b]

[b]SuggestiveEndings:[/b] Enable/Disable suggestive endings for your dates. These endings are [b][u]not NSFW[/u][/b], but they can be disabled if you would rather keep it PG. [b][Default: true][/b]

[b]AllowRoommateDates: [/b]Enable/Disable being asked on a date by a platonic roommate. Currently supports Krobus (vanilla), Apples ([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url]), Mr. Ginger ([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5295]Mister Ginger - Cat NPC[/url]), and Juna ([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8606?tab=articles]Juna - Roommate NPC[/url]﻿). NOTE: This does not make events platonic, just simply undoes the block that prevents them from occurring. The dialogue will still be heavily romantic for now. If you have a roommate not supported, please make a post on the mod page and I'll be happy to add compatibility! [[b]Default: false]. 

DatesOnFestivalDays[/b]: Enable/Disable being asked on a date on a festival day. Usually many areas are closed or off-limits on festival days, making it impossible for you to complete the date if asked. Enabling this will allow dates to be asked on a date with a festival, even if you won't be able to complete it. When disabled, dates will never be asked on every festival day (except the Night Market). Works on every vanilla festival and the two new Ridegside Village festivals.[b] [Default: false][/b]

[b]UniqueDateChance[/b]: Choose the chance that, when asked on a date, it will be a spouse-unique date (given the spouse has the chance of asking specific date event). This will not affect anything if your spouse has no unique dates yet. If set to 0, disables spouse-specific unique dates. If set to 100, disables generic dates for spouses with specific events (if your spouse does not have any unique dates yet they will still ask for generic dates). [b][Default: 25%][/b]

[b]LibraryDateCutscene:[/b] Enable/Disable the book cutscene section of the library date. I recommend seeing it at least once, but if you would like to cut it out to make the dates overall shorter, you can disable this after. [b][Default: true]

DisabledDates[/b]: Enable/Disable certain vanilla spouses from asking you on a date. Works well with mods like Platonic Partners and Friendships, if you have a platonic housemate that is usually romanceable. If an NPC has this set to true, then this NPC will never ask you on a date. [b][Default: false for all][/b]

[b]GenderedDialogue:[/b] Enable gendered dialogue for dialogue used in Date Night events. Note: Due to the large number of dialogues in this mod, I was unable to catch all dialogue errors, so please inform me if you encounter any strange dialogue![b] [Default set to false][/b]

[b][size=5][img]https://i.imgur.com/pvmEy4L.png[/img][/size]

[/b]This mod [b]should be compatible[/b] with most mods. Here are some popular ones:

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url]: Fully Compatible. The map changes do not affect anything with the events, and all custom spouses (ex: Victor, Sophia) will ask you on dates and attend the dates as expected.

[b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside Village[/url][/b]: Fully Compatible. All custom spouses should ask/attend dates.

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10206]Looking for Love[/url]: Compatible will all Spouses.

[b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10021]Free Love[/url] / [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6227]Multiple Spouses[/url] / Polyamory Mods:[/b] Should be compatible, however, I believe only your most recent Spouse or your "official" Spouse will ask you on dates. You can change this in Free Love by giving the spouse you want to go on a date with a Boquet.

[b][color=#f1c232]Other Custom Spouses:[/color][/b] Should be fully compatible with all custom spouses (including SVE and RSV spouses). As of update 1.2.0, all mods that make vanilla characters romanceable are fully compatible as well.

[color=#f1c232][b]Sprite and Portrait Edits[/b]:[/color] Should be fully compatible. 

[color=#f1c232][b]Map Edits:[/b] [/color]I cannot guarantee that the events work with mods that edit the maps of the vanilla areas (except for SVE, which I tested and made sure compatible). If you find something odd, please make a bug report! Worst case, the game shouldn't break, but the events may glitch, freeze, or just look weird (NPCs walking into objects, etc.).[color=#ffd966][b]If you find a conflict with a map mod, please tell me which mod it was  and I will be more than happy to add compatibility for that mod.[/b][/color]

[color=#ffd966][b]Multiplayer[/b]:[/color] Should be fully compatible when married to an NPC. Will obviously not work if married to another player.

[b][size=5][img]https://i.imgur.com/Ajn4GMK.png[/img][/size][/b]

This is my first mod, so I am not the most efficient at modding, but I have many future plans for updates to this mod! Here are some of things I hope to include some time in the future:

[b]More Date Types:[/b] Adding more generic date types for you and any spouse to have.
[b]Randomized Dates:[/b] Adding more random dialogue/elements to make each date unique and interesting!
[b]Unique Dates For Vanilla Spouses:[/b] Adding custom dates for the Vanilla Spouses that match their character and add more personality to them!
[b]Pre-Marriage Dates:[/b] Adding dates that you can go on when you aren't married yet! (Thanks to BubbleBeam for this idea!)
[b]Family Days:[/b] Adding events after you have kids where you can go out with your family.

[size=4][b]Thanks for reading, and I hope you enjoy the mod!

[/b][/size]If there are any issues, please tell me so I can fix them ASAP!
